## Optimizing Ticket Sales
The ntickets function calculates the optimal number of tickets to sell for a flight to maximize revenue while keeping the risk of overbooking below a specified threshold (gamma).

Example Usage
In this example:

N = 400: The plane has 400 seats.

gamma = 0.02: We accept a 2% risk of overbooking.

p = 0.95: There is a 95% probability a passenger shows up.

## Code Example
```{r}
ntickets(N = 400, gamma = 0.02, p = 0.95)
```
